name: Stolen Freewind Supplies
label: Quest
description: Jandia in Freewind Post needs stolen supplies recovered from the harpies. Without another shipment, the post will soon run short.
intro: Jandia in Freewind Post needs stolen supplies recovered from the harpies. Without another shipment, the post will soon run short.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
